issues.problem: to-conditional mistake note said 'even when the result is in the past', but the example result was non-past; 道が滑ります was also stiff.
issues.action: Rewrote note (と never follows the past form; last verb carries tense); changed both sentences to 滑りやすくなります.

issues.problem: ba-conditional explain said an action ば-clause can never take a request/intention main clause; false when A is someone else's action (君が行けば僕も行く).
issues.action: Restricted the rule to the speaker's/listener's own action and added the counterexample.

issues.problem: tara-conditional explain claimed たら is the only one of the four that freely takes any main clause; なら also takes requests and advice freely.
issues.action: Reworded to 'unlike と, and unlike ば after an action'.

issues.problem: tara-conditional mistake 'bad' sentence 安いたら lacked braces, unlike every other bad/good sentence.
issues.action: Marked as 安[やす]い{たら}.

issues.problem: nara-conditional explain said 'there is never a だ in front of it', which contradicts だったなら (valid).
issues.action: Changed to 'No だ goes in front of it: 雨なら, not 雨だなら'.
